navigator

Page Link

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
url String No Jump link in the current Mini Program.
open-type String navigate No Jump mode.
delta Number 1 No Number of levels of fallback. It is available when open-type is set to navigateBack.
hover-class String navigator-hover No Style class for tapping. If hover-class is set to none, no tapped style is available.
hover-stop-propagation Boolean false No Whether to prevent the ancestor node from being tapped.
hover-start-time Number 50 No Tapping duration before the tapped state is displayed, in milliseconds.
hover-stay-time Number 600 No Retention time of the tapped state after the button is released, in milliseconds.

Valid Values of open-type

Value Description
navigate Corresponds to the ma.navigateTo or ma.navigateToMiniProgram function.
redirect Corresponds to the ma.redirectTo function.
switchTab Corresponds to the ma.switchTab function.
reLaunch Corresponds to the ma.reLaunch function.
navigateBack Corresponds to the ma.navigateBack function.

Sample Code


<view>
  <view>
    <navigator url='exampleUrl1' class='navigator'>
      <button type='default'>navigateToPage1</button>
    </navigator>
    <navigator url='exampleUrl2' class='navigator' open-type='redirect' hover-class='other-navigator-hover'>
      <button type='default'>redirectToPage2</button>
    </navigator>
    <navigator url='/page/tabbar/component/index' class='navigator' open-type='switchTab'
               hover-class='custom-navigator-hover'>
      <button type='default'>switchTab</button>
    </navigator>
    <navigator url='exampleUrl3' open-type='reLaunch' class='navigator'>
      <button type='default'>reLaunchPage3</button>
    </navigator>
    <navigator open-type='navigateBack' class='navigator' delta='1'>
      <button type='default'>navigateBack</button>
    </navigator>
  </view>
</view>

.navigator-hover button {
    background-color: #DEDEDE;
}

.other-navigator-hover button {
    background-color: #DEDEDE;
}

.navigator {
    padding: 10px
}

.custom-navigator-hover {
    background-color: pink;
}

.other-navigator-hover {
    background-color: rgb(228, 206, 7);
}

Bug & Tip

1.The default background color of navigator-hover is {background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); opacity: 0.7;}, indicating that the background of the navigator child node is transparent.
